title: RS Context Neo — Regional Configuration
description: Defines the DEM source, hydrology parameters, and optional data layers for one regional deployment of RS Context Neo. Pair this profile with per-run flags (--aoi, --output, --force, --debug) on the command line.

$schema.description: URI reference to this schema. Used by editors for validation and auto-complete.

profile_name.description: Short human-readable name for this profile, e.g. 'US CONUS' or 'New Zealand'.

description.description: Longer description of this profile: region covered, data sources used, known limitations, etc.

download_dir.description: Persistent cache directory for downloaded DEM files. Re-used across runs so tiles are not re-fetched. Required for both 'tnm' and 'wcs' sources. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

scratch_dir.description: Temporary working directory for unzipped tiles and intermediate files. Defaults to <download_dir>/scratch when omitted. Safe to delete after each run. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

dem.title: DEM Acquisition
dem.description: Controls how the project DEM is obtained. Three acquisition modes are supported: 'tnm' (USGS National Map tile download, US only), 'wcs' (any OGC WCS endpoint), and 'file' (local file path). String values support {env:VAR} substitution.

source.description: 'tnm' — USGS National Map 3DEP tile API (contiguous US + Alaska). 'wcs' — any OGC WCS 1.0.0 endpoint; configure the URL and coverage in wcs_options. 'file' — use a local DEM file specified by filepath.

aoi.description: Path to GeoJSON AOI file for downloading tiles. Required when source is 'tnm' or 'wcs'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

resolution.description: Target output resolution in metres. At 1 m a 100 km² watershed produces a ~10 GB DEM; scale up for large or memory-constrained runs. The hydrology threshold should be scaled proportionally: threshold ≈ 50000 × (resolution / 1)².

filepath.description: Path to a local DEM file. Required when source is 'file'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

tnm_options.title: National Map (TNM) Options
tnm_options.description: Fine-tuning options for the 'tnm' source. Ignored when source is 'wcs' or 'file'.

download_workers.description: Number of tiles to download in parallel. Each tile is an independent HTTPS download; 4 workers saturates a typical connection without hammering the USGS TNM servers.

buffer_deg.description: Degrees to buffer the AOI bounding box when querying The National Map for tiles. The small buffer ensures tiles that partially overlap the AOI edge are included.

wcs_options.title: WCS Options
wcs_options.description: Configuration for the 'wcs' source. Required when source is 'wcs'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution in all string fields.

url.description: Base URL of the OGC WCS 1.0.0 endpoint, without query parameters. Example: 'https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer/WCSServer'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

coverage.description: WCS coverage identifier (the layer name passed to the COVERAGE parameter). Obtain from the service's GetCapabilities response. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

version.description: WCS protocol version. Only 1.0.0 has been tested.

format.description: Requested response format. Must be a format string accepted by the WCS endpoint.

tile_pixels.description: Maximum pixel dimension (width and height) per WCS tile request. Large coverages are split into a grid of tiles each no larger than this. Keep below the server's hard pixel limit (ArcGIS Image Server enforces 4096 px; 2000 is a safe default).

download_workers.description: Number of WCS tile requests to issue in parallel.

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout in seconds per individual tile request.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of download attempts per tile (1 original + N-1 retries). Retries apply to 5xx server errors, connection errors, and GDAL validation failures.

retry_backoff_s.description: Initial back-off delay in seconds before the first retry. Doubles on each subsequent attempt (exponential back-off).

hydrology.title: Hydrology Parameters
hydrology.description: Parameters controlling the D8 hydrology processing chain (WhiteboxTools breach conditioning + TauDEM flow routing + stream network extraction).

threshold.description:
Minimum upstream cell count to classify a cell as stream (units: cells). At 1 m resolution, 50 000 cells = 0.05 km² of contributing area.
**Scaling for coarser DEMs:** threshold ≈ 50000 / (resolution_m)²
*   At 3 m resolution: threshold ≈ 50000 / 9 ≈ 5556 cells
*   At 10 m resolution: threshold ≈ 50000 / 100 = 500 cells
**Higher values** → fewer, larger streams (coarser network)
**Lower values** → more, smaller streams (denser network)
**Important:** This formula provides a starting point. Adjust based on your watershed size and desired detail:
*   For small watersheds (<10 km²), consider using 10000–30000 to capture headwater channels
*   For large watersheds (>100 km²), you may want 100000+ to focus on mainstem rivers
*   See [STREAM_THRESHOLD.md](../docs/STREAM_THRESHOLD.md) for guidance on post-compute filtering using the `USContArea` field.

breach_dist.description: WhiteboxTools breach depression maximum distance (in cells). Controls how far pits will be drained to fix depressions before flow routing. Lower values are more aggressive at preserving shallow depressions; higher values fill more aggressively. Set to 0 to disable breach depression preprocessing.

cores.description: Number of CPU cores to use for WhiteboxTools and TauDEM operations. null means use all available cores.

oneOf.$comment: s3tables — fetches vector layers from AWS S3 Tables via Athena
oneOf.title: S3Tables Layer

id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output GeoPackage path relative to the project output folder.

athena_output.description: S3 path for Athena query results, e.g. 's3://bucket/athena-output/'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

layer_name.description: Layer name in the Athena table.

s3tables_path.description: s3tables:// ARN for the source table. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

oneOf.$comment: cog_clip — clips a remote Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF to the AOI
oneOf.title: COG Clip Layer

id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output raster path relative to the project output folder, e.g. 'vegetation/evt.tif'.

url.description: URL or GDAL virtual path to the source raster. Use '/vsicurl/https://...' for HTTPS COGs, '/vsis3/bucket/key' for S3 objects, or a plain local path. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

band.description: Raster band to extract. Defaults to band 1.

nodata.description: Nodata value to assign in the output raster. null uses the source raster's nodata value.

oneOf.$comment: wfs — fetches vector features from an OGC WFS endpoint
oneOf.title: WFS Layer

id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output GeoPackage path relative to the project output folder.

url.description: Base URL of the OGC WFS endpoint, without query parameters. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

typename.description: WFS feature type name (the TYPENAMES parameter). Obtain from the service's GetCapabilities response. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

layer_name.description: Name for the layer inside the output GeoPackage.

version.description: WFS protocol version. '2.0.0' is recommended; use '1.1.0' for older services.

oneOf.$comment: raster — clips a raster (local or S3 COG) to the project extent
oneOf.title: Raster Layer

input.description: Source raster: relative project path, absolute local path, or s3://bucket/key URI. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

output_path.description: Output path relative to project output folder. Defaults to 'input' if input is relative, or derived from the input URI basename otherwise.

oneOf.$comment: wcs_raster — fetches a raster from an OGC WCS endpoint
oneOf.title: WCS Raster Layer

id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output raster path relative to the project output folder.

url.description: Base URL of the OGC WCS endpoint. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

coverage.description: WCS coverage identifier (layer name). Obtain from the service's GetCapabilities response. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

layer_name.description: Key used to register this raster in the project XML, e.g. 'PRECIPITATION'.

metadata.title: Project Metadata Defaults
metadata.description: Key-value pairs added to the Riverscapes project XML as hidden metadata. Merged with (and overridden by) any --meta values passed on the command line. Supports {env:VAR} substitution in values.
